children: U.S. WTI Midland crude differentials jumped on Monday after a trade in the Platts window, while Chevron bid for Brent, Forties, Oseberg and Ekofisk.
Indications are free on board unless marked as cost, insurance and freight or delivered at place.
WTI Midland: Vitol bought a September 26-30 cargo from BP at dated Brent plus $4.95 CIF Rotterdam.
The deal level equated to around dated plus $3.30 FOB, Reuters calculations showed.
WTI last traded on September 2, when Exxon bought September 14-18 from Trafigura at dated Brent plus $1.55 CIF Rotterdam, equivalent to about dated Brent minus 18 cents FOB.
Brent/Ninian: Chevron bid for October 6-10 at dated Brent plus $5.80 CIF Rotterdam, which equated to around dated plus $3.06 FOB, according to Reuters calculations.
Forties: Chevron bid for October 7-9 at dated Brent plus $3.50. Exxon bid for September 26-October 9 at dated plus $1.75.
Oseberg:  Chevron bid for October 4-6 at dated Brent plus $6.10.
Ekofisk: Chevron bid for October 5-7 at dated Brent plus $5.10.
Johan Sverdrup: Equinor bid for a September 30-October 2 cargo at dated Brent plus $1.20.
